lessons.title: Sequences and series: AP and GP
lessons.programRef: A Level Pure Mathematics — Sequences and series: arithmetic and geometric progressions, sums, sum to infinity (to be checked against the official syllabus)
lessons.author: CastBridge (AI draft)
lessons.source: Original writing following the A Level Pure Mathematics syllabus; to be reviewed by a teacher
objectives: Find the nth term and the sum of n terms of an arithmetic progression.
Find the nth term and the sum of n terms of a geometric progression.
Decide when a geometric series converges and find its sum to infinity.
reviewNotes: Check the official syllabus for sigma notation, the binomial expansion and recurrence relations, which this lesson does not cover.
The FCFA savings problem is an original invented situation, not a real data set.

blocks.title: Example 1: an AP
blocks.statement: An AP has first term 5 and common difference 3. Find the 20th term and the sum of the first 20 terms.

blocks.title: Example 2: a GP
blocks.statement: A GP has first term 3 and common ratio 2. Find the 6th term and the sum of the first 6 terms.

blocks.title: Example 3: sum to infinity
blocks.statement: Find the sum to infinity of $12 + 4 + \frac{4}{3} + \dots$

steps.md: The ratio is $r = \frac{4}{12} = \frac{1}{3}$ and $|r| < 1$, so the sum exists.

blocks.title: Common mistakes
blocks.md:
- Using n instead of n − 1 in $u_n = a + (n - 1)d$.
- Using $S_\infty$ when $|r| \geq 1$: the series then has no finite sum.
- Mixing the two sum formulas: check whether the sequence adds (AP) or multiplies (GP).
